author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Wolff Olins
summary: A studio or agency in London since 1965. It builds identity around an organisation’s strategic idea and accepts systems that may be variable, contentious and deliberately open-ended.

hero_image.alt: A wall of pale study sheets pinned edge to edge in a loose grid, a work lamp below them and a table of trials running out of frame.
hero_image.caption: An identity argued on the wall: dozens of trials kept up at once so the system can be judged whole.
